rationale: Seventeenth pass: request execution for the node-layer claim that is currently source-only. The harness exercises the pendingReadIndex object directly in the root package: a request is registered with a five-tick timeout, dequeued into a batch with a fresh SystemCtx and no ready-to-read index, the logical clock advances past the deadline, and one applied(0) call is delivered as an event-loop iteration would. If the deadline path is as traced, the request's completed channel receives RequestTimeout; if the batch can be stranded, no result arrives and the test fails. The harness is submitted for isolated execution against the captured tree; no conclusion is asserted before the receipt exists.

scope.description: Exercise pendingReadIndex registration, batching without a ready-to-read index, clock advance past the caller deadline, and one applied call to observe whether RequestTimeout is delivered.

experiment.prefix: The test constructs a sync.Pool of RequestState, a readIndexQueue of size 16 and a pendingReadIndex; registers one read with a five tick timeout through pendingReadIndex.read; dequeues the request from the queue and adds it under a freshly generated SystemCtx so the batch has no index; advances the pendingReadIndex logical clock to tick 6; then calls applied(0) once, as handleEvents does for an event-loop iteration. Only the request object, its queue and its clock are involved: no raft node, nodehost, transport or state machine participates, so the observation covers the node-layer bookkeeping alone.
